items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: A guy named Moon Mullins and his partner Lamont, and Larry DeVito, a very fine Italian tenor saxophone player, who was really a great player.

ctx.x: But anyway, getting back to the music. Down in Paradise Alley, that's where the action was. The Turf Club was there on St. Antoine. They had the D&C across the street, where we used to go over there and jam. And they had some very well-known saxophone players who used to play around there. A guy named Moon Mullins and his partner Lamont, and Larry DeVito, a very fine Italian tenor saxophone player, who was really a great player.

In fact, this place is where I first met Yusef Lateef. Now, his name was Bill Evans at the time. In fact, I taught him... I was the first guy to teach him the chord changes to a song. It was "Coquette", "My Little Coquette." Yeah...
